output.headline: Call Advocate Health and UPMC first, then Nordic Capital; price at the top of the range
sentences: Call Advocate Health first, then Nordic Capital and UPMC: Advocate pays above the comparable median, UPMC has a perfect close record, and Nordic Capital has the deepest sponsor provider record. [E:tier1]

Upper-quartile pricing of 15.3x EBITDA is defensible given our margin, and the strategics can clearly pay it; sponsors reach about $193M to $216M, so synergy-backed strategics are better placed. [E:valuation, E:lbo]
The review removed Steward Health Care (bankrupt), folded Atrium Health into Advocate Health, and set aside Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners as off-mandate. [E:review, E:tier2]
Most buyers in provider deals are after geographic expansion, which our Midwest footprint serves, so lead every call with that. [E:motives, E:target]
